typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	OLEDBDestination_outputfilename as string (),
	userName as string ()
}

source(output(
		{Data Center Name} as string,
		{PDU Number} as string,
		{PDU Name} as string,
		{Consumed kW} as double,
		kW as double,
		{Date of Readings} as date
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> FlatFileSource
FlatFileSource derive(UploadDate = currentTimestamp(),
		ETLUser = $userName) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		UploadDate as date 'dd-MM-yyyy',
		ETLUser as string,
		PDU_Number as string,
		PDU_Name as string,
		kW as double,
		DataCenterName as string,
		ConsumedkW as double,
		DateofReading as date 'dd-MM-yyyy'
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		UploadDate,
		ETLUser,
		PDU_Number = {PDU Number},
		PDU_Name = {PDU Name},
		kW,
		DataCenterName = {Data Center Name},
		ConsumedkW = {Consumed kW},
		DateofReading = {Date of Readings}),
	partitionFileNames:[($OLEDBDestination_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> OLEDBDestination
